name: aggregate_phase_outputs
description: 阶段节点输出聚合技能。在阶段节点执行后，聚合 outputForNext 有效输出，提炼关键字段并可回写汇总节点，同时记录审计日志与可选 SSE 事件。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"planId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"计划ID"},"phaseId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"阶段ID"},"summaryNodeId":{"type":"string","description":"可选汇总节点ID，传入则回写 outputForNext"}},"required":["planId","phaseId"]}
thoughtChain: 加载阶段节点并筛选存在 outputForNext 的有效节点输出。
生成阶段聚合结果；若传入 summaryNodeId 则回写该节点 outputForNext。
记录审计日志并可选推送 SSE，确保阶段中继行为可追溯。
